title: AI Padel Coaching Mobile App MVP – React Native / Flutter
skills: AI (ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE) HW/SW | AI (Artificial Intelligence) HW/SW | React Native | Video Processing | AI Development | AngularJS | PHP | Node.js | JavaScript
full_description:
Overview:

I’m building a mobile-first AI sports coaching platform for padel tennis that combines:

* AI-powered video analysis of player matches
* Human coach feedback system
* Booking system for coaching sessions
* Player progress tracking over time

This is an MVP stage project, but it must be built with a scalable architecture for future AI expansion.

I am looking for a serious full-stack mobile developer or small team with experience in:

* React Native (or Flutter if strongly justified)
* Backend development (Firebase / Supabase / Node.js)
* Video processing workflows
* Basic AI / computer vision integration (or ability to implement APIs)

⸻

Core MVP Features:

1. User App (Mobile)

* User registration / login
* Upload padel match videos (from phone)
* View AI-generated analysis report
* View coach feedback
* Booking coaching sessions

⸻

2. Video Analysis System (MVP version)

Initial version does NOT need full custom AI model.

Acceptable approach:

* Video upload → backend processing
* Frame extraction (ffmpeg or similar)
* AI-generated insights via API (OpenAI or similar vision-capable model)
* Output structured feedback:
 * positioning mistakes
 * shot selection issues
 * tactical advice
 * 2–3 drills for improvement

Important: system must be built so AI layer can be improved later.

⸻

3. Coaching Booking System

* Calendar-based booking (availability slots)
* Stripe payments integration
* Coach assignment system (simple version)

⸻

4. Admin Panel (Basic)

* View users
* View uploaded videos
* View coaching bookings
* Manage pricing

⸻
Technical Requirements:

You MUST have experience in:

* React Native or Flutter production apps
* Backend APIs (Node.js / Firebase / Supabase)
* Stripe integration
* File/video upload systems
* Working with AI APIs (OpenAI, vision models, or similar)

Bonus (strong advantage):

* Experience with sports analytics apps
* Video processing pipelines (ffmpeg, cloud storage)
* AI agent workflows or automation systems

⸻

Important Notes:

* This is NOT a UI-only project
* This is NOT a simple CRUD app
* You must be able to design scalable architecture
* You must be comfortable working with ambiguous AI requirements
* Clean, modular code is essential (this will scale into a startup)

⸻

Deliverables:

1. Fully working mobile MVP (iOS + Android)
2. Backend API + database setup
3. Video upload + processing pipeline
4. AI feedback system (API-based acceptable for MVP)
5. Booking + Stripe payment system
6. Basic admin dashboard
7. Deployment setup

⸻

Budget:

Open to proposals.

Please break down:

* MVP cost
* Timeline (weeks, not months)
* Tech stack recommendation

I am prioritising:

* Quality architecture
* Fast MVP delivery
* Scalability for AI expansion

⸻

To Apply, please include:

1. Examples of apps you’ve built (especially mobile apps)
2. Any experience with video processing or AI APIs
3. Your recommended tech stack for this project
4. Rough timeline + cost estimate
5. One suggestion on how you would improve this product

⸻

Generic proposals will be ignored.

I am specifically looking for developers who understand:

* product thinking
* scalable architecture
* AI integration potential
